source.publisher: Massachusetts Department of Revenue, Division of Local Services, Data Analytics and Resources Bureau (databank@dor.state.ma.us)

localoptions.title: Adopted Local Options Relating to Property Tax

source.method: Logi report CSV export (rdReportFormat=CSV) with all municipalities selected; tools/build_town_tax_options.py

as_of: Each DLS report prints 'Data current as of <date>' = propertytax 09/25/2026, localoptions 09/25/2026, cpa 09/25/2026, deferrals 09/25/2026. That appears to be the page-render date, not a data vintage; the underlying records are whatever towns have filed with DLS.
caveats: null means the source does not show it -- never read null as 'not adopted'.
The Adopted Local Options report says: 'This information is self-reported and only shows the current unexpired data'.
41C option values (*_on_file) are what the town filed with DLS and are often stale; see spot_checks. Methuen (age 65, $1,000) shows NO 41C options in DLS.

Senior work-off (5K), veterans work-off (5N), 5C1/2 additional exemption, 41D CPI indexing, 41A local income limit/interest rate, 17D COLA, 22 increases and c.60 s.3D funds are NOT in any public DLS report.
Devens appears in two DLS reports but is not one of the 351 municipalities; excluded.

spot_checks.summary: 41C age on file matched the town's own document in 6 of 7 towns; 41C amount on file matched in only 3 of 7. DLS option data is a lower bound and often stale. Stoneham's document was generic, so it is excluded from the counts.

Methuen.town: age 65 (methuen.gov/168/Exemptions-Information); council resolution text raises 41C from $750 to $1,000 (methuen.gov/DocumentCenter/View/2163)

Boston.town: age 65, $1,000 in FY2027 plus up to $1,000 more (boston.gov/departments/assessing/elderly-exemption-41c)

Acton.town: age 65, 'up to $2,000' (FY26 tax relief packet; likely 41C + 5C1/2, not verified)

fields.elderly_exemption_clause: [PT] 'Elderly Person Exemption Clause Adopted' as DLS shows it: '41C', '41B' or '41C 1/2'.
fields.elderly_exemption_clause_adopted: [PT] its adoption date/year, raw (DLS mixes '1987' and '5/6/1987').
fields.clause_41c_adopted: [PT] true if DLS shows Clause 41C. null otherwise (NOT proof it was not adopted).
fields.clause_41c_half_adopted: [PT] true if DLS shows Clause 41C 1/2 (income tracks the Circuit Breaker). null otherwise.
fields.clause_41c_options_on_file: [PT] true if any 'Clause 41C Options' column (St.2002 c.184 s.51: lower age to 65, raise amount up to +100%, raise income/asset limits) is filled. null = none on file with DLS; Methuen shows why that is NOT proof of none.
fields.clause_41c_age_on_file: [PT] qualifying age on file (statute default 70). 0/blank -> null. Matched the town's own document in 6 of 7 spot checks.
fields.clause_41c_amount_on_file: [PT] exemption $ on file (statute $500; option up to $1,000). STALE: matched the town's own document in only 3 of 7 spot checks. Do not show as the resident's amount.
fields.clause_41c_income_limit_single_on_file: [PT] gross-receipts limit filed with the 41C options (single). Towns with Clause 41D (not in DLS) index this to CPI, so current limits are higher.
fields.clause_41c_asset_limit_single_on_file: [PT] whole-estate limit filed with the 41C options (single). Same 41D caveat.
fields.clause_41c_options_raw: [PT] the 7 raw 41C option cells (0 = item not changed), for audit.
fields.clause_37a_blind_adopted: [PT] true if DLS shows a Clause 37A (blind, $500) adoption date. null otherwise.
fields.state_reimb_cap_clause17_dollars: [PT] 'Clause 17 cap (if applicable)': the STATE REIMBURSEMENT cap for 17C/17C1/2/17D ('cannot exceed the amount reimbursed under Clause 17', DLS Cherry Sheet Manual). Not a resident benefit; do not display.
fields.state_reimb_cap_clause41_count: [PT] 'Clause 41 Exemption Cap': NUMBER of 41B/41C exemptions the state reimburses (capped at the last Clause 41 count, Cherry Sheet Manual). Not a resident benefit; do not display.
fields.residential_exemption_pct: [LO] residential exemption % (not senior-specific). null = not shown.
fields.senior_means_tested_exemption: [LO] true if 'Senior Means Tested Exemption Granted' = Yes (home-rule means-tested senior exemption, e.g. Sudbury). null otherwise.
fields.cpa_listed: [CPA] true if the town appears in DLS's CPA report; false if it does not (a statement about the report).
fields.cpa_adopted: [CPA] true if an adoption year is shown. null if not listed or listed without a year (e.g. Andover).
fields.cpa_exempt_low_income_and_senior: [CPA] true if 'Low Income Exemption' adopted: G.L. c.44B s.3(e)(1), property of a person who would qualify for low-income housing or low/moderate-income senior housing. null otherwise.
fields.cpa_exempt_first_100k_residential: [CPA] true if 'Residential Assessed Value' ($100,000 of residential value exempt from the surcharge) adopted. null otherwise.
fields.cpa_exempt_first_100k_commercial_industr: [CPA] true if the commercial/industrial exemption is adopted. null otherwise.
fields.deferral_41a_latest_fy: [DEF] fiscal year the two fields below describe (the latest FY in the report).
fields.deferral_41a_count_latest_fy: [DEF] Clause 41A deferrals granted that FY, as reported to DLS. 41A deferral exists in every town by statute; 0 means none granted, not 'unavailable'.
fields.deferral_41a_count_last5fy: [DEF] total 41A deferrals granted over the latest 5 FYs reported.
fields.senior_work_off_5k_adopted: NOT IN ANY PUBLIC DLS REPORT -- null for every town. Senior property-tax work-off abatement, G.L. c.59 s.5K
fields.veteran_work_off_5n_adopted: NOT IN ANY PUBLIC DLS REPORT -- null for every town. Veteran property-tax work-off abatement, G.L. c.59 s.5N
fields.additional_exemption_5c_half_adopted: NOT IN ANY PUBLIC DLS REPORT -- null for every town. Optional additional exemption up to +100%, G.L. c.59 s.5C1/2
fields.clause_41d_cpi_indexing_adopted: NOT IN ANY PUBLIC DLS REPORT -- null for every town. Clause 41D: annual CPI increase of 41C income/asset limits
fields.deferral_41a_local_income_limit: NOT IN ANY PUBLIC DLS REPORT -- null for every town. Clause 41A deferral: locally adopted income limit
fields.deferral_41a_interest_rate: NOT IN ANY PUBLIC DLS REPORT -- null for every town. Clause 41A deferral: locally adopted interest rate
fields.clause_17d_cola_adopted: NOT IN ANY PUBLIC DLS REPORT -- null for every town. Clause 17D annual COLA (CPI) acceptance
fields.clause_22_local_increase_adopted: NOT IN ANY PUBLIC DLS REPORT -- null for every town. Local increase of Clause 22 veteran exemptions
fields.tax_aid_fund_60_3d_adopted: NOT IN ANY PUBLIC DLS REPORT -- null for every town. Voluntary tax-aid fund for elderly/disabled, G.L. c.60 s.3D
fields.clause_56_guard_exemption_adopted: NOT IN ANY PUBLIC DLS REPORT -- null for every town. Clause 56 National Guard / reservist exemption
